#### Ethical Gathering [DRS]

*Source: [Diamond Spheres: Invention & Ingenuity](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/en/product/505704/diamond-spheres-invention-and-ingenuity?affiliate_id=3028400)*

**Prerequisites:** Harvest package.

You cannot harvest components from corpses, and gain the Humane Survivalist talent.

#### Hunter

You do not gain the talisman (harvest) talent, and cannot create talismans. You gain a (harvest) talent instead.

**Author's Note:** This sphere-specific drawback can be taken as a [utility start] if the talent(s) gained as part of the drawback are [utility] talents.

#### Resourceful Laborer [alternate start]

You use Craft (taxidermy) or Profession (architect, butcher, farmer, gardener, miner, monster slayer, siege engineer, trapper, or woodcutter) as your associated skill for the Survivalism sphere, in addition to using your ranks in that skill when meeting prerequisites that require the Survivalism sphere.

#### Slow Dredger

**Prerequisites:** (dredge) package.

You cannot dredge as a full-round action, and must spend the normal 10 minutes of work to dredge. You gain the Efficient Preparation talent instead.

#### Survivalist [DRS]

*Source: [Diamond Spheres: Invention & Ingenuity](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/en/product/505704/diamond-spheres-invention-and-ingenuity?affiliate_id=3028400)*

You do not gain a Survivalism package. You gain the Natural Shelter, Subduer, or Survival Instinct talent. If you choose a [utility] talent, the base sphere gains the [utility] tag.

#### Particular Trencher [DRS]

*Source: [Diamond Spheres: Harmony & Discord](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/en/product/492540/diamond-spheres-harmony-and-discord?affiliate_id=3028400)*

**Prerequisites:** (dredge) package.

Choose either harmful or beneficial dredge options; once chosen, this cannot be changed. You may only use dredge options of the chosen kind. A ‘harmful’ dredge option is something that applies a penalty or similar impediment (such as difficult terrain or a pit), whereas a ‘beneficial’ dredge option is one that applies a benefit or removes impediments (such as the Cleared Terrain option).

If you chose harmful dredge, you gain the Meticulous Hunter talent as a bonus talent, whereas if you chose beneficial dredge, you gain the Complex Preparation talent as a bonus talent.
